metadata.name: sar
metadata.description: Collect, report, or save system activity

installation.note: sar is part of sysstat; enable sadc collection (e.g., in /etc/default/sysstat) for historical data

overview.summary: sar (system activity reporter) reports CPU, memory, I/O, network, and other activity. It can show current stats or historical data if sysstat collection is enabled. Useful for post-incident analysis and capacity planning.
when_to_use: View historical CPU, I/O, or network usage
Analyze system activity over a time range

syntax.description: Without INTERVAL, sar may show historical data (if available). With INTERVAL, it samples live; COUNT limits samples.

options.description: Start (-s) and end (-e) time for historical data

examples.title: Historical CPU (if collected)
examples.description: Show today's CPU history from saved data

related_commands.description: I/O and CPU stats (same sysstat package)
